items.title: Josiah "Cie" Frazier Interview
items.q: Claiborne Williams, from Napoleonville, Louisiana. Claiborne Williams' oldest son. That's George Williams.

ctx.x: Can you pin down and tell us what is the difference between the New Orleans beat and the other, can you explain any of that? Well I wouldn't know that. I didn't know that. Can you explain any of that?

Yes, it's a single beat you had, a steady single beat you had on a bass drum, you know, playing these different styles of marches. But they raid our whole band in New Orleans, in Great Lakes, when we was formerly, a band consisted of 23 men and one with the chief make 24. When we break it down to 15 or 16-piece dance obviously, we didn't have no special arrangement during the training time, so we played stock music in the training camp. And they considered it mostly like New Orleans style with the attack. Other…
I was going to say he was Claiborne, I was going to ask if he was...
